context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about archive holdings
purpose: Teach: 東部/神戸大/人事院/十字架/日月/智/峰/陰謀

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 当館の資料、東部関連のものが特に多いです。
lines.en: Our collection has quite a lot of materials focused on the eastern region in particular.
lines.style: Measured, professional tone. Slight pause before 'eastern region' — marking a key point. Clear enunciation. The practiced ease of someone explaining something many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 神戸大の歴史学科とも、過去に共同調査をしたとお聞きしました。
lines.en: I heard that you've collaborated with Kobe University's history department in the past.
lines.style: Respectful but engaged — not deferential. Slight lift at the end of the question, showing genuine interest. Careful pronunciation, student-careful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。人事院の制度史も、断片的に資料が残っています。
lines.en: Yes. Records of the personnel board's institutional history also survive, though scattered.
lines.style: Confirmatory nod in the voice. Steady, measured pacing. A slight weight on 'scattered' — acknowledging the limitation without apology. Professional and honest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宗教関連の遺物、十字架のレプリカもあるんですね。
lines.en: There are religious artifacts here too — even replicas of crosses.
lines.style: Open, curious intonation. Slight emphasis on 'even' — the pleasurable discovery of an unexpected detail. Bright, engaged energy without performing excitement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 時代によって、日月の周期に合わせた装飾も加わります。
lines.en: The decorative styles actually shift with the era — they were designed to align with lunar and solar cycles.
lines.style: Warm, explanatory tone. A small smile in the delivery — the satisfaction of sharing something intricate. Unhurried pacing, letting each element land clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 峰のように一族の系譜が並ぶ家系図、智の継承を感じます。
lines.en: The family trees displayed like peaks — there's something moving about how wisdom gets passed down through these lines.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative pace. Soft opening. The words themselves matter here — slight pause before 'peaks.' A note of genuine thoughtfulness, not performance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 陰謀論扱いされる箇所もあるので、引用は慎重に願います。
lines.en: Some of this material gets caught up in conspiracy theories, so I'd ask that you be careful with attribution.
lines.style: Shift to professionalal caution. Clearer, firmer delivery — not unkind, but marking a boundary. Straightforward. The tone of someone protecting both the material and the researcher.
